children: QuidelOrtho entered into Amendment No. 1 to its credit agreement, covering $3.4 billion of senior secured facilities, to reset financial covenants and adjust pricing. The amendment establishes a covenant relief period through September 30, 2029 with revised maximum leverage and minimum interest coverage ratios, and updates pricing for the Term Loan A facilities and revolver while leaving Term Loan B interest unchanged. The facilities remain guaranteed by material U.S. subsidiaries and secured by substantially all assets, subject to customary exclusions. The company expects the changes to enhance flexibility and support ongoing operations.
: Amendment to senior secured credit facilities ($3.4B total)
: Bank of America and other lenders
: Reset covenants and pricing to enhance financial flexibility
